evidence.notes: UserInfo.getLocale reads the current runAs user's LocaleSidKey, with the local default remaining en_US.
UserInfo.getLanguage reads the current runAs user's LanguageLocaleKey, without enabling locale-sensitive formatting.

source.content: @isTest private class CoreUserInfoLocaleLanguageFixtureTest { @isTest static void localeAndLanguageFollowRunAsUser() { System.assertEquals('en_US', UserInfo.getLocale()); System.assertEquals('en_US', UserInfo.getLanguage()); System.runAs(new User(Id = '005-locale-user', LocaleSidKey = 'de_DE', LanguageLocaleKey = 'fr', TimeZoneSidKey = 'Europe/Berlin')) { System.assertEquals('de_DE', UserInfo.getLocale()); System.assertEquals('fr', UserInfo.getLanguage()); TimeZone tz = UserInfo.getTimeZone(); System.assertEquals('Europe/Berlin', tz.getID()); Datetime stamp = Datetime.valueOfGmt('2024-07-01T12:00:00Z'); System.assertEquals('2024-07-01 14:00:00 +0200 CEST', stamp.format('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss Z z', 'Europe/Berlin')); } System.assertEquals('en_US', UserInfo.getLocale()); System.assertEquals('en_US', UserInfo.getLanguage()); } }
